errors: experiments/m7an_bisect/run.py first imported 7am's run.py with `import run`, which collided with m6_poshold's `import run` (sys.modules name clash); fixed by loading it with importlib under another name and popping sys.modules['run'] while it loads

doc_friction.issue: pyenv.py pytest numpy matplotlib scipy returned an interpreter without cma, which every codesign-cant experiment needs through m6_poshold; the project's pyproject lists it, so `pyenv.py -r` style install from pyproject would have avoided a failed first import

notes: Milestone 7an of codesign-cant: bisected each flight's critical start offset along 16 directions for 7am's 36 designs x 64 plants (quiet+O 16 angles, full 8), 1,618 s on 4 cores. Predictions RC0-RC6 committed before the run script; RC0, RC1, RC5 held, RC2, RC3, RC4, RC6 refuted. Post hoc ablation (couple=False) traces the x/y asymmetry to the cant side force. Added poshold.rollout start_off (inert by default; reproduces 7am's 464 deaths exactly with the reference offsets; test added). Checks run locally: tests/test_bisect_7an.py, test_roa_kp_7am.py, test_paper_numbers.py, test_poshold.py pass; research/_homepage/build.py ok; research_live_links, check_md_links, check_posts, programme_check ok.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a controls researcher scripting a per-direction bisection over 36 designs, an ablation and the write-up: about a working day plus

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
